markdown.html: The Pain & Neurorecovery Group is part of the University Clinic for Neurorehabilitation at Aarhus University and is based at Hammel Neurocenter, a highly specialized national center for neurorehabilitation after acquired brain injury. The group brings together experimental, translational, and clinical expertise across multiple disciplines. It also operates the Hammel Pain Physiology Lab, an embedded hospital-based facility that gives participants convenient access to experimental studies and clinical trials.
